commands: uv run harness exposure corpus --embodiment franka --seed 470001 --output analysis/safety-exposure/ablation/sfe-held-command-ablation-v2/corpus.json

equivalence_margin.not_applicable: superiority contrast on illegal traces; legal traces use an exact zero-intervention rule

smallest_effect.measure: paired risk difference in traces with at least one driver-received violation

decision_rules.stopping_rule: fixed frozen corpus; no trace added or removed after registration

primary.aggregation: paired difference guard_on - guard_observe_only with session bootstrap

secondary.aggregation: count from trusted contact instrument or unmeasured

exclusions.deviation_policy: any behaviour-affecting change after registration is a documented deviation record and a new campaign version id; confirmatory data never revises the registered protocol
infrastructure: emergency-containment activation in either arm invalidates the pair (SFE-10)
exclusions.rerun_policy: a permitted rerun receives a new randomized id; the original row is retained with its exclusion reason and never replaced in place
treatment_integrity: proposal bytes or contract timestamps differ between arms (SFE-9)
observe-only authority observed inside a participant process

hypotheses.statement: On kinematically illegal command traces, guard_on yields fewer driver-received kinematic violations per trace than guard_observe_only.
On legal negative-control traces, guard_on forwards every proposal unchanged (zero interventions); any change blocks the study (SFE-11).

instrument_set.note: base keep-out and arm/base mutual exclusion are not applicable to the arm-only SO-101 embodiment and are recorded as not_applicable

integrity_checks.owner_role: ablation engine (fake driver only; decision logs identical across arms; containment identical)
corpus builder (six families, legal controls, watchdog silence)

seed_commitment.rule: the corpus seed is public by design (SFE-9 freezes trace bytes and hashes); the commitment exists for registry uniformity

superseded: sfe-held-command-ablation-v1 (registered before the corpus and engine existed)
